THE SEE SUBJECT

Look together, one card at a time.

See is the subject behind your baby’s visual world: noticing bold shapes, focusing, following with their eyes and meeting your face.

See is the subject behind your baby’s visual world: noticing bold shapes, focusing on what interests them, following things with their eyes and meeting your face. Classes in this subject start with plain high-contrast cards and grow with your baby — faces and tracking, then strong single colours and familiar objects. Every See class is short, calm and designed to be led by you.

Lesson 1 · Birth–6 weeksSee

High-Contrast Cards

Twelve black and white cards, shown one at a time. Two to five minutes, no printing, no setup — just look together.

Start today’s class ↗
Lesson 2 · 6–12 weeksSee

Faces & Visual Tracking

Simple faces, gentle patterns and a first taste of colour, with slow side-to-side tracking. Two to five calm minutes at a time.

Start today’s class ↗
Lesson 3 · 3–4 monthsSee

Colors & First Objects

Bold red, yellow and blue alongside familiar objects — a ball, a cup, a spoon, a teddy. Name them if you like; there is nothing to test.

Start today’s class ↗
